decision.trend: Research on high-entropy alloys has been focused on understanding their mechanical properties, such as strength, toughness, and creep resistance, under various conditions, including high-temperature mechanical loading. The studies have shown that these alloys exhibit exceptional properties, such as high strength, toughness, and resistance to creep, due to their unique microstructures and deformation mechanisms. The trend is to investigate the effects of composition, processing, and testing conditions on the mechanical properties of high-entropy alloys, with a focus on understanding the underlying mechanisms and optimizing their performance for specific applications.
